posts.title: Laminar Field Nodes: Implementing Linear Flow Typing
posts.description: For an overview of the paper this is based on, check out this post . Here are my notes about trying to implement a linear/flow language in typescript, compiling to javascript. It uses runtime checks to enforce lienarity; so far there is no type checker. 5 minute read

posts.title: Papers We Love: Flow Typing, A New Lens on Linearity
posts.description: In my various efforts to develop new programming languages, I’ve occasionally looked sidelong at linear types, as something that looks like it could be really useful if it wasn’t so incredibly cumbersome. And now some folks have come up with a way to make them much easier to use [^1]! Or at least that’s the hope. This past week I’ve been trying to implement their execution model into a new program
